long_biography.plain_text:
Naro began on Wall Street at Dreyfus before building a credit-markets career at Bear Stearns and UBS. At UBS, he became a managing director and global co-head of fixed income, serving on the investment bank's board before co-founding Sailfish Capital. He later held senior positions at Markit and Jefferson National Financial.

In 2012, he established Coherence as an independent home for the investment process developed across those earlier roles. Lazard subsequently brought the team into its alternative-investment platform, and Corvid Peak acquired it in 2023. Naro continues to direct the business, preserving its specialist credit focus while operating within the wider Tiptree Advisors organization.
